name: C1 — 高级
description: 在商务、学术和新闻语境中运用英语。捍卫观点、构建正式话语,并自如地使用习语。

topics.title: 商务英语
topics.description: 会议、谈判与正式书面沟通

guide.intro: 商务英语生存于远高于日常用语的语域中。报告中常用 「in light of」、「given the fact that」、「on account of」 来替代日常的 「because」。C1 阶段要教的不仅是词汇,更是如何始终保持语域的一致性。

sections.text: 正式语域中的因果连接词
「Because」 属于日常口语。在正式写作中,人们更倾向使用 「in view of」、「given that」、「in light of」、「owing to」。「Therefore」、「hence」、「consequently」 看似同义,但 「hence」 略显文言,「consequently」 则带有更浓的学术色彩。
谈判中的软化表达
在商务谈判中,说「不」的方式有几十种。「I'm afraid that won't be possible」、「We may have difficulty meeting that figure」、「Let me get back to you on that」 都是委婉的拒绝。中文里那种间接拒绝的反射(例如「现在很难」)在英语谈判中起到相同的作用。

rows.source: I'm afraid that won't be feasible at this stage.
rows.translation: 恐怕在现阶段难以落实。

rows.source: We may have difficulty meeting that figure.
rows.translation: 我们可能难以达到这个数字。

rows.source: Let me get back to you on that.
rows.translation: 关于这一点,我回头再答复您。

rows.source: I'd like to push back on that timeline.
rows.translation: 我想对这一时间表提出异议。

sections.text: 在英语商务环境中,关键不仅在于选词,更在于你的措辞有多委婉。从中文切换到英语的专业人士常犯的错误是:直接说 「It is not possible」 就戛然而止。更自然的版本是:「I'm afraid that may not be feasible right now — perhaps we could explore an alternative?」

lessons.title: 开始会议
lessons.description: 问候、议程与致谢

exercises.prompt: 「今天的议程涵盖三个主要议题」用英语怎么说?
options: Today's agenda covers three main points.
exercises.answer: Today's agenda covers three main points.

exercises.prompt: Thank you all for ___ time to attend.
exercises.answer: taking the
exercises.explanation: 「taking the time to」 = 「抽出时间」。
exercises.hint: 感谢各位抽出时间来参加。

exercises.prompt: 开场句式 — 功能
「我谨代表公司向各位致以热烈的欢迎。」
exercises.answer: On behalf of the company I extend a warm welcome to everyone

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句在会议中存在语域(register)错误?
options: I'd like to begin by reviewing last quarter's results.
Yo team, let's smash this Q3 review.
Let's get started by going through the agenda.
exercises.answer: Yo team, let's smash this Q3 review.
exercises.explanation: 「Yo team」 与 「smash」 对正式会议而言过于俚语化。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Without further ado, let's dive into the agenda.
options: Without further ado, let's dive into the agenda.
Without farther ado, let's dive into the agenda.
Without further to do, let's dive into the agenda.
With further ado, let's dive into the agenda.
exercises.answer: Without further ado, let's dive into the agenda.

exercises.prompt: In light ___ recent developments, we'll add an item.
exercises.answer: of

exercises.prompt: 在会议语境中,「hand it over to someone」 的意思是什么?
exercises.answer: 把发言权交给 Sarah。
exercises.explanation: 「hand over to」 是会议中常见的短语动词,意为「把话筒/发言权交给某人」。中文「移交」并不能完全覆盖这一动作。

exercises.prompt: 「考虑到时间有限,我们简短地谈一谈。」
exercises.answer: Given the limited time let's keep it brief

exercises.prompt: Today's session will run for ___ hour and a half.
exercises.answer: an
exercises.explanation: 此处 「h」 不发音,故用 「an hour」。

exercises.prompt: 「I'd like to extend a warm welcome」 这一表达的细微含义是什么?
exercises.answer: 热情而正式的欢迎
exercises.explanation: 「extend a welcome」 是固定的正式搭配,直译「延伸欢迎」是中文 L1 学习者的常见错误;请整体记忆。

exercises.prompt: 「此刻我把发言权交给我的同事。」
exercises.answer: At this point I'll hand over to my colleague

lessons.title: 谈判语言
lessons.description: 软化语气、反提议、底线

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句以最得体的外交辞令拒绝了一项提议?
options: I'm afraid that won't be feasible at this stage.
exercises.answer: I'm afraid that won't be feasible at this stage.

exercises.prompt: We may have ___ meeting that figure.
exercises.answer: difficulty
exercises.hint: 我们要达到那个数字可能有难度。

exercises.prompt: 谈判句式 — 功能

pairs.left: Let me get back to you.

exercises.prompt: 「我想对这一时间表提出异议。」
exercises.answer: I'd like to push back on that timeline

exercises.prompt: 「That's a non-starter」 是什么意思?
options: 这是个完全无法接受的提议
exercises.answer: 这是个完全无法接受的提议
exercises.explanation: 中文直译「不是开始者」会丢失语义;在谈判中 「non-starter」 等于「根本谈不下去」。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We have some flexibility on volume but not on price.
options: We have some flexibility on volume but not on price.
We had some flexibility on volumes but not on price.
We have some flexibility on volume but not on prices.
We have some flexible on volume but not on price.
exercises.answer: We have some flexibility on volume but not on price.

exercises.prompt: We can meet you ___
exercises.answer: halfway
exercises.hint: 我们可以各让一步。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句属于「坚决拒绝」?
options: We can probably work something out.
There may be room for compromise.
exercises.answer: That's a deal-breaker for us.

exercises.prompt: 「我与团队商议后再回复你。」
exercises.answer: I'll get back to you after consulting my team

exercises.prompt: Could we explore some ___ options?
exercises.answer: alternative
exercises.hint: 我们能不能探讨一些其他的方案？

exercises.prompt: 「We're prepared to walk away」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 我们准备退出谈判。
exercises.explanation: 中文直译「走开」无法表达谈判语境;「walk away」 在商务英语中是固定习语,意为「离开谈判桌、不再继续」。

exercises.prompt: 「按这个价位我们无法继续推进。」
exercises.answer: We can't move forward at this price point

lessons.title: 正式书面沟通
lessons.description: 电子邮件、报告与合同语言

exercises.prompt: 在一封正式邮件中,「您将如何描述下个季度的展望?」 该怎样表达?
options: How would you characterise your outlook for the coming quarter?
Tell me about next quarter, dude.
exercises.answer: How would you characterise your outlook for the coming quarter?

exercises.prompt: Pursuant ___ our discussion…
exercises.answer: to
exercises.explanation: 「pursuant to」 = 「依据/据此」(正式)。

exercises.prompt: 商务书信用语 — 中文
「如有疑问,请不要犹豫,随时联系我们。」
exercises.answer: Should you have any queries please do not hesitate to reach out

exercises.prompt: 在合同中,「aforementioned」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 前述、上文已提及的
exercises.explanation: 「aforementioned」 = 前述,合同与正式文书专属;中文里「上述」「前述」均可对应。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Notwithstanding the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.
options: Notwithstanding the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.
Not withstanding the delay, the deliverable remain unchanged.
Notwithstanding the delays, the deliverables remained unchanged.
Notwithstand the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.
exercises.answer: Notwithstanding the delay, the deliverables remain unchanged.

exercises.prompt: I am writing in ___ to your inquiry.
exercises.answer: response
exercises.hint: 现就您的咨询作答复。

exercises.prompt: 在正式报告中,「we discovered」 通常会被替换为什么?
exercises.answer: the analysis revealed

exercises.prompt: 「请您审阅我们的提案后再回复,十分感激。」
exercises.answer: We kindly ask that you revert after reviewing our proposal

exercises.prompt: The contract shall be ___ effective upon signing.
exercises.answer: deemed
exercises.explanation: 「shall be deemed」 属于合同用语。
exercises.hint: 合同自签署之日起视为生效。

exercises.prompt: 「We regret to inform you」 带有怎样的语气?
exercises.answer: 正式地传达负面消息
exercises.explanation: 中文「很遗憾通知您」 = 英语 「We regret to inform you」;后者多用于正式商务/法律书面拒绝。

exercises.prompt: 「我们遗憾地通知您,您此次的申请将不会继续推进。」
exercises.answer: We regret to inform you that your application will not be progressing this time

lessons.title: 战略与决策
lessons.description: 风险、机会与优先级排序的语言

exercises.prompt: 战略术语 — 中文

pairs.right: 容易摘到的果实(易得收益)

exercises.prompt: 「low-hanging fruit」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 容易摘到的成果
exercises.explanation: 比喻型习语:不能字面理解。「low-hanging fruit」 在商业语境中 = 「容易拿下的收益/机会」。

exercises.prompt: This initiative gives us a competitive ___
exercises.answer: edge
exercises.hint: 这个举措让我们具备了竞争优势。

exercises.prompt: 「为降低风险,我们必须使资源多元化。」
exercises.answer: We need to diversify resources to mitigate risk

exercises.prompt: 在战略报告中,「going forward」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 今后 / 自此往后
exercises.explanation: 「going forward」 在商业语境中是高频副词性短语,等同于「from now on」 或 「henceforth」;中文 L1 常误译为「向前走」。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We need to mitigate risk while pursuing growth.
options: We need to mitigate risk while pursuing growth.
We need to mitigated risk while pursuing growth.
We need to mitigate risks while pursuing growths.
We need to mitigate risk while perusing growth.
exercises.answer: We need to mitigate risk while pursuing growth.

exercises.prompt: The investment yields ___ returns at this scale.
exercises.answer: diminishing
exercises.hint: 在这种规模下，投资的回报递减。

exercises.prompt: 在商业语境中,「pivot」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 调整战略方向
exercises.explanation: 源自篮球「中枢脚」隐喻;现代商业 = 公司转型/转向新方向。中文「转型」更接近此意,「转向」也可。

exercises.prompt: 「该公司转向了 B2B 业务。」
exercises.answer: The company pivoted to B2B

exercises.prompt: It's a ___ proposition for both sides.
exercises.answer: win-win
exercises.hint: 对双方来说都是双赢。

exercises.prompt: 「The deal must have fallen through last night.」 = ?
options: 这笔交易昨晚一定泡汤了。(对过去的强推测)
这笔交易昨晚必须泡汤。
这笔交易昨晚也许泡汤了。
exercises.answer: 这笔交易昨晚一定泡汤了。(对过去的强推测)
exercises.explanation: 「must have + V3」 = 对过去事实的强烈推测(基于现在的证据)。中文 L1 易把它和 「had to」(过去的义务)混淆,但语义截然不同。

exercises.prompt: 情态完成式 — 中文

pairs.right: 本可以做(有能力但未必做)

lessons.title: 撰写高管摘要
lessons.description: 面向高层管理者:简洁、克制、以行动为导向

exercises.prompt: 作为高管摘要的开篇,下列哪句最为恰当?
options: We have done a lot of stuff this quarter and want to share it.
This memo summarises Q3 performance, headline risks and the recommended course of action.
Hi team, here's what's been going on lately.
So basically the quarter went okay-ish.
exercises.answer: This memo summarises Q3 performance, headline risks and the recommended course of action.
exercises.explanation: 高管摘要在一句话中浓缩范围、风险和建议。

exercises.prompt: Revenue grew 12% year-on-year, ___ by enterprise renewals.
exercises.answer: driven
exercises.explanation: 在高管摘要中,「driven by」 用于说明增长的原因。
exercises.hint: 由于企业续约的推动，营收同比增长了百分之十二。

exercises.prompt: 高管摘要的表达 — 其功能
「我们的建议是将资源重新分配到上层细分市场。」
exercises.answer: Our recommendation is to reallocate resources to the upper segment

exercises.prompt: 「Headwinds notwithstanding, margins held steady.」 是什么意思?
options: 尽管面临不利因素,利润率保持稳定。
风变大了,利润率下降了。
利润率随着逆风一起上升。
exercises.answer: 尽管面临不利因素,利润率保持稳定。
exercises.explanation: 「headwinds」 在商业语境中是「不利因素」的比喻;「X notwithstanding」 是 C1 级倒装让步,等同于 「despite X」 但更正式。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.
options: On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.
On balanced, the quarter exceeded expectation despite supply-side pressures.
On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-sided pressure.
Of balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.
exercises.answer: On balance, the quarter exceeded expectations despite supply-side pressures.

exercises.prompt: The proposal is, on ___, the most defensible option available.
exercises.answer: balance
exercises.hint: 总的来说，这个提案是目前最经得起推敲的方案。

exercises.prompt: 高管摘要中存在语域错误的是哪一句?
options: We absolutely crushed it last quarter, no cap.
Customer retention remained the principal lever for growth.
The data points to a structural rather than cyclical decline.
exercises.answer: We absolutely crushed it last quarter, no cap.
exercises.explanation: 「No cap」 与 「crushed」 不适合高管摘要。

exercises.prompt: 「尽管利润不及预期,现金流仍然稳健。」
exercises.answer: While profit fell short of expectations cash flow remained robust

exercises.prompt: The board is asked to ___ the proposed reallocation.
exercises.answer: endorse
exercises.explanation: 「endorse」 在正式批准场合常用。
exercises.hint: 请董事会批准所提议的资源重新分配方案。

exercises.prompt: 「Subject to board approval」 这一表达的作用是什么?
options: 以获得董事会批准为前提
董事会尚未讨论此议题
exercises.answer: 以获得董事会批准为前提
exercises.explanation: 「subject to X」 = 「以 X 为条件 / 待 X 成立」;在合同与高管摘要中是固定表达,中文「以……为准/前提」。

exercises.prompt: 「该风险看似可控,但仍需密切监控。」
exercises.answer: The risk appears manageable but warrants close monitoring

lessons.title: 正式电子邮件语域
lessons.description: 开头、请求、结尾:该选哪种语气

exercises.prompt: 给重要客户写邮件时,最合适的开场是哪一句?
options: I trust this email finds you well.
exercises.answer: I trust this email finds you well.
exercises.explanation: 正式而礼貌的开场;「I hope this finds you well」 是较中性的变体。

exercises.prompt: I am writing to ___ a meeting at your earliest convenience.
exercises.answer: request
exercises.hint: 现致函请求尽早安排会面。

exercises.prompt: 正式结尾用语 — 含义

pairs.right: 不知收件人姓名时(Dear Sir/Madam)
知道收件人姓名时(Dear Mr Smith)

exercises.prompt: 「事先感谢您的回复。」
exercises.answer: Thank you in advance for your reply

exercises.prompt: 下列哪种表达能礼貌地软化请求?
options: I would be most grateful if you could send the report by Friday.
Why haven't you sent it yet?
exercises.answer: I would be most grateful if you could send the report by Friday.

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
options: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Should you required any further informations, please do not hesitate to contact me.
If you require any farther information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
Should you require any further information, please not hesitate to contact me.
exercises.answer: Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

exercises.prompt: Apologies for the ___ in responding.
exercises.answer: delay
exercises.hint: 回复较晚，深表歉意。

exercises.prompt: 人们如何理解 「Per our last conversation」 这一表达?
options: 略带正式,有时带些施压意味(尤其是用于提醒对方时)
exercises.answer: 略带正式,有时带些施压意味(尤其是用于提醒对方时)
exercises.explanation: 「per」 = 「依据/根据」;直译中文「按照我们上次的对话」 显得平淡,但英语职场邮件里该句已成为「我提醒你一下」的礼貌施压套路。

exercises.prompt: 「我们清楚此事的紧迫性,会给予应有的重视。」
exercises.answer: We appreciate the urgency of the matter and will give it due care

exercises.prompt: Please find ___ the revised proposal.
exercises.answer: attached
exercises.hint: 修订后的方案见附件。

exercises.prompt: 「I just wanted to circle back on…」 这一表达的微妙含义是什么?
options: 我第一次开启这个话题
我礼貌地回到我们之前讨论过的话题
exercises.answer: 我礼貌地回到我们之前讨论过的话题
exercises.explanation: 「circle back」 = 「绕回来」,职场邮件常用;中文直译「绕回去」不通顺,需整体理解为「再回到那个问题上」。

exercises.prompt: 「我会记下此事,下周再来跟进。」
exercises.answer: I will make a note to follow up on this next week

lessons.title: 对话:季度董事会汇报
lessons.description: 向持怀疑态度的董事会成员解释未达成的目标

exercises.prompt: 董事会会议 — 第三季度业绩未达标

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Let's get to it. Revenue came in eight percent below guidance — walk us through what happened.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式开场:在承担责任的同时,选择一个用分裂句构建背景的表达
options: What we underestimated was the timing of the procurement freeze, not the underlying demand.
We didn't know that the procurement freeze would happen, so we missed it.
Basically the procurement freeze caught us with our pants down, that's the story.
turns.answer: What we underestimated was the timing of the procurement freeze, not the underlying demand.

turns.speaker: board
turns.text: Timing aside, the same risk surfaced last quarter. Why wasn't it priced into the forecast?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 倒装强调(inversion)— 请补全助动词
turns.before: Granted, the signal was there, but
turns.after: we anticipate buyers consolidating orders this aggressively.
turns.answer: nor did

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: And the proposed remediation? I'd like specifics, not aspirations.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 请在正式语域中选择一个具体的承诺
options: We're going to, like, hustle harder on the pipeline next quarter, no worries.
We've recalibrated the pipeline coverage ratio to three-to-one and tied commercial bonuses to attainment.
Honestly, we'll just hope the macro turns around and pray for the best.
turns.answer: We've recalibrated the pipeline coverage ratio to three-to-one and tied commercial bonuses to attainment.

turns.speaker: board
turns.text: That addresses execution. What about exposure if the freeze persists into Q4?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式条件状语 — 请填空
turns.after: , we have a contingency plan that protects roughly seventy percent of the gap.
turns.answer: extend

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Useful. One last thing — how confident are you in the Q4 number you're now putting forward?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: C1 模糊语 — 表达自信但不过度自负
options: I'm a hundred percent sure, no doubt about it whatsoever.
Honestly, who knows, it's anyone's guess at this point.
I'd characterise it as cautiously confident — the downside scenarios are now adequately hedged.
turns.answer: I'd characterise it as cautiously confident — the downside scenarios are now adequately hedged.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Noted. We'll reconvene in six weeks for a mid-quarter check-in. Thank you.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Thank you. I'll circulate the updated forecast and remediation plan by close of business Friday.

topics.title: 学术英语
topics.description: 构建论证、引用来源、答辩论文

guide.intro: 学术英语将论断与证据绑定,使用模糊语,并倾向名词化表达。中文学术风格往往容许长句;而英语学术风格则偏好简洁清晰的句子、明确的论点和带有模糊语的阐释。

sections.text: 学术模糊语
学者们不会直接说 「X is true」,而会写 「The data suggest that X may be the case」。这是一种礼貌的克制:数据可能改变,也存在其他解读。
名词化
学术英语偏爱把动词改写为名词:不说 「They decided to invest」,而说 「The decision to invest…」 或 「Their investment decision…」。这能使句子更紧凑,也使语气更客观。

rows.source: The findings suggest that climate policy may have unintended effects.
rows.translation: 研究结果表明,气候政策可能存在未曾预料的副作用。

rows.source: A growing body of evidence indicates that…
rows.translation: 越来越多的证据表明……

rows.source: This study seeks to address that gap.
rows.translation: 本研究旨在填补这一空白。

sections.text: 学术写作中很少出现 「I think」,取而代之的是 「It is argued that」、「this paper contends that」。这相当于中文学术风格中用「认为」「学界普遍认为」来替代「我觉得」的偏好。

lessons.title: 模糊语与主张力度
lessons.description: 根据数据调整断言强度

exercises.prompt: 模糊语 — 中文释义
下列哪一句的主张语气最弱?
options: The data clearly show that X.
The data may suggest that X could occur.
exercises.answer: The data may suggest that X could occur.

exercises.prompt: A growing ___ of evidence indicates climate sensitivity.
exercises.answer: body
exercises.hint: 越来越多的证据表明气候系统具有敏感性。

exercises.prompt: 「本研究旨在填补这一空白。」
exercises.answer: This study seeks to address that gap

exercises.prompt: 「It is argued that…」 是什么意思?
options: 有人主张……(刻意避开「我认为」)
exercises.answer: 有人主张……(刻意避开「我认为」)
exercises.explanation: 学术英语用被动 + 名词化避免主观「我」;中文学术写作里的「学界普遍认为」对应此用法。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The findings appear to support our hypothesis.
options: The findings appear to support our hypothesis.
The findings appears to support our hypothesis.
The findings appear to supports our hypothesis.
The finding appear to support our hypotheses.
exercises.answer: The findings appear to support our hypothesis.

exercises.prompt: These results ___ that further investigation is warranted.
exercises.answer: indicate
exercises.hint: 这些结果表明有必要进行进一步研究。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪种形式属于学术文本中的名词化表达?
options: The decision to invest proved costly.
exercises.answer: The decision to invest proved costly.

exercises.prompt: 「数据表明,该假设无法被拒绝。」
exercises.answer: The data suggest that the hypothesis cannot be rejected

exercises.prompt: The phenomenon ___ to occur more frequently in summer.
exercises.answer: tends
exercises.hint: 这种现象在夏季往往更为频繁。

lessons.title: 构建论文
lessons.description: 阐述、辩护、设定边界

exercises.prompt: 在学术论文中,「thesis statement」 是什么?
options: 作者所主张的核心论点
exercises.answer: 作者所主张的核心论点
exercises.explanation: 中文「论点」并非论文标题;「thesis statement」 特指引言段中作者亮明的核心主张。

exercises.prompt: This paper ___ that…
exercises.answer: argues
exercises.hint: 本文论证……

exercises.prompt: 论文常用句式 — 中文释义
「本研究提出了一个新的理论框架。」
exercises.answer: This study proposes a novel theoretical framework

exercises.prompt: 「In contrast to prior literature, we find…」 用中文该怎么说?
options: 未与已有文献产生交集……
与已有文献相反,我们发现……
exercises.answer: 与已有文献相反,我们发现……
exercises.explanation: 「in contrast to」 = 「与……相反」,学术英语用于表明研究与前人立场不同;中文常用「相反/不同于」。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Drawing on prior research, we extend the framework.
options: Drawing on prior research, we extend the framework.
Drawing in prior research, we extend the framework.
Drawing on priors research, we extends the framework.
Drawn on prior research, we extend the framework.
exercises.answer: Drawing on prior research, we extend the framework.

exercises.prompt: The findings have important ___ for policy.
exercises.answer: implications
exercises.hint: 这些发现对政策具有重要意义。

exercises.prompt: 学术文本中使用 「we」 的情况如何?
options: 在部分学科中可被接受,在其他学科里倾向于使用被动语态。
exercises.answer: 在部分学科中可被接受,在其他学科里倾向于使用被动语态。
exercises.explanation: 中文学术写作回避「我」,英语在不同学科有不同惯例:理工科常用被动,人文社科可用 「we」。

exercises.prompt: 「研究结果表明,现有理论存在不足。」
exercises.answer: The findings indicate that existing theory falls short

exercises.prompt: The limitations of this study ___ as follows.
exercises.answer: are

lessons.title: 数据讨论
lessons.description: 结论、阐释、局限

exercises.prompt: 数据相关句式 — 中文释义
「statistically significant」 用中文怎么说?
options: 在统计学上具有显著性
exercises.answer: 在统计学上具有显著性
exercises.explanation: 「significant」 在学术英语 ≠ 中文「重要的」;它专指「显著」(p < 0.05 等)。中文 L1 学习者常误以为「significant = important」。

exercises.prompt: As ___ in Table 2…
exercises.answer: shown
exercises.hint: 如表二所示……

exercises.prompt: 「这一效应在不同性别之间相似。」
exercises.answer: The effect is similar across genders

exercises.prompt: 「a robust effect」 是什么意思?
options: 稳健的、在不同控制变量下都不消失的效应
exercises.answer: 稳健的、在不同控制变量下都不消失的效应
exercises.explanation: 「robust」 在中文里直译「强壮」会偏离意思;统计语境下指「稳健」,即结果在多种模型设定下都成立。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The correlation is statistically significant at the one percent level.
options: The correlation is statistically significant at the one percent level.
The correlation is statically significant at the one percent level.
The correlation are statistically significant at the one percent level.
The correlations is statistically significant at the one percent levels.
exercises.answer: The correlation is statistically significant at the one percent level.

exercises.prompt: The sample is ___ relatively small.
exercises.answer: however
exercises.hint: 然而，样本相对较小。

exercises.prompt: 在结论部分,「These findings should be interpreted with caution」 是什么意思?
options: 这些发现是绝对确定的。
exercises.answer: 请审慎解读这些发现。
exercises.explanation: 学术模糊语标志:作者主动提醒读者注意结论的局限性。中文「请谨慎解读」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 「效应大小随时间推移而增大。」
exercises.answer: The effect size increases over time

exercises.prompt: Future research should ___ this question further.
exercises.answer: investigate
exercises.hint: 未来的研究应进一步探讨这一问题。

lessons.title: 学术综合 — 复习
lessons.description: 论文、模糊语与数据阐释

exercises.prompt: 「Notwithstanding these caveats, the results suggest…」 用中文怎么说?
options: 尽管存在这些保留意见,结果仍暗示……
由于这些保留意见,无任何结果。
这些保留意见很重要,故无结论。
这些保留意见已被驳回。
exercises.answer: 尽管存在这些保留意见,结果仍暗示……
exercises.explanation: 「caveat」 = 注意事项/保留意见(学术用词);「notwithstanding X」 = 「尽管 X」(正式)。

exercises.prompt: The results are robust ___ a number of specifications.
exercises.answer: to

exercises.prompt: 「我们在本文中提出了一种新的机制。」
exercises.answer: In this paper we proposed a novel mechanism

exercises.prompt: 学术连接词 — 中文释义
出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The literature suggests that this effect is well-established.
options: The literature suggests that this effect is well-established.
The literature suggest that this effect is well established.
The literature suggests that this effects is well-established.
The literatures suggest that this effect is well-established.
exercises.answer: The literature suggests that this effect is well-established.

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句包含主观个人主张?(在学术写作中通常需要回避)
options: I think we should reject the hypothesis.
The data appear to reject the hypothesis.
The hypothesis is rejected at the 1% level.
It is argued that the hypothesis can be rejected.
exercises.answer: I think we should reject the hypothesis.

exercises.prompt: Conversely, ___ found no such effect.
exercises.answer: we

exercises.prompt: 「thereby」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 由此/因而
exercises.explanation: 「thereby」 = 借此/由此(正式连接词);常用于学术写作连接因果。

exercises.prompt: 「这些发现以三种方式为相关文献做出贡献。」
exercises.answer: The findings contribute to the literature in three ways

exercises.prompt: The effect is statistically ___
exercises.answer: significant
exercises.hint: 这一效应在统计上是显著的。

lessons.title: 文献综述模式
lessons.description: 引用先前研究、综合、识别空白

exercises.prompt: 在文献综述中,「X 研究者主张……」 最恰当的英文表达是什么?
exercises.answer: X (2019) argues that…
exercises.explanation: 在学术引用中,通常会标注年份并使用 「argues / contends / posits」。

exercises.prompt: Smith (2021) ___ a similar conclusion in a different setting.
exercises.answer: reaches
exercises.explanation: 「reach a conclusion」 / 「draw a conclusion」 两种说法均可接受。
exercises.hint: Smith（2021）在另一情境下得出了类似的结论。

exercises.prompt: 引用动词 — 功能
「现有文献对这一机制基本保持沉默。」
exercises.answer: The existing literature is largely silent on this mechanism

exercises.prompt: 「A growing body of research suggests that…」 这一句式的功能是什么?
options: 概述不断扩张的研究文献
exercises.answer: 概述不断扩张的研究文献
exercises.explanation: 「a growing body of research / evidence」 是学术综述常用句式;中文对应「越来越多的研究表明……」。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remain underexplored.
options: While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remain underexplored.
While prior works have focused on outcomes, the underlying process remain underexplored.
While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remains underexplored.
While prior work had focused on outcome, the underlying processes remain underexplored.
exercises.answer: While prior work has focused on outcomes, the underlying processes remain underexplored.

exercises.prompt: This study seeks to ___ that gap in the literature.
exercises.answer: address
exercises.hint: 本研究旨在填补文献中的这一空白。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句是用来表明「理论框架」的?
options: We use Maslow's hierarchy as our theoretical lens.
We have a lot of stuff in mind.
We thought of stuff and went with it.
Maslow is famous, so we used it.
exercises.answer: We use Maslow's hierarchy as our theoretical lens.
exercises.explanation: 「Theoretical lens / framework」 是学术写作的固定表达。

exercises.prompt: 「研究结果在一定程度上反驳了先前的结论。」
exercises.answer: The findings partially refute earlier results

exercises.prompt: Recent scholarship has called this assumption into ___
exercises.answer: question
exercises.explanation: 「call sth into question」 = 使……受到质疑。
exercises.hint: 近期的学术研究对这一假设提出了质疑。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句是反驳某研究者论点的最学术化表达?
options: However, Smith's account underestimates the role of context.
Smith doesn't know what he's talking about.
exercises.answer: However, Smith's account underestimates the role of context.

exercises.prompt: 「围绕该议题尚未形成共识。」
exercises.answer: No consensus has yet emerged on the subject

lessons.title: 摘要写作
lessons.description: 高度浓缩的信息:目的、方法、发现、结论

exercises.prompt: 一篇摘要(abstract)通常按怎样的顺序写就?
options: 结论 → 发现 → 方法 → 目的
目的 → 方法 → 发现 → 结论/建议
方法 → 目的 → 建议 → 讨论
讨论 → 引言 → 结论 → 方法
exercises.answer: 目的 → 方法 → 发现 → 结论/建议
exercises.explanation: 英语摘要遵守 IMRD 缩略顺序;中文学术摘要常更松散,但英语期刊要求严格。

exercises.prompt: This paper ___ the relationship between X and Y.
exercises.answer: examines
exercises.hint: 本文考察了 X 与 Y 之间的关系。

exercises.prompt: Abstract 部分 — 典型动词/表达
「本研究采用了混合方法的研究路径。」
exercises.answer: This study adopts a mixed methods approach

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句对于一篇 abstract 而言显得过于随意(informal)?
options: Our analysis reveals a robust association.
We sort of looked into how things turned out.
The findings suggest a moderating role of context.
exercises.answer: We sort of looked into how things turned out.
exercises.explanation: 「Sort of」 与 「turned out」 不符合摘要的语域要求。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The findings have wider implications for policy and practice.
options: The findings have wider implications for policy and practice.
The finding have wider implication for policy and practice.
The findings has wider implications for policy and practice.
The findings have wider implication for policies and practice.
exercises.answer: The findings have wider implications for policy and practice.

exercises.prompt: Drawing ___ a sample of 240 firms, the analysis reveals…
exercises.answer: on
exercises.explanation: 「Drawing on / upon」 = 依据……。
exercises.hint: 本研究基于对 240 家公司的样本进行分析，结果表明……

exercises.prompt: 「The implications are twofold」 这一表达的含义是什么?
exercises.answer: 意涵体现在两个方面
exercises.explanation: 「twofold / threefold / X-fold」 = 「分 X 个方面」,学术英语固定表达;中文「双重意义」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 「这些结果为因果性阐释提供了稳健的基础。」
exercises.answer: The results provide a robust basis for a causal interpretation

exercises.prompt: These findings ___ light on a long-standing debate.
exercises.answer: shed
exercises.explanation: 「shed/throw/cast light on」 = 阐明、揭示。
exercises.hint: 这些发现为一场长期的争论提供了启示。

exercises.prompt: 在一篇 abstract 中,「we conclude that」 的更具模糊语色彩(更为谨慎)的替代表达是什么?
exercises.answer: We tentatively suggest that
exercises.explanation: 在学术语言中,「tentatively suggest」 = 谨慎地提出。

exercises.prompt: 「这些结果应在考虑到样本较小的情况下加以解读。」
exercises.answer: The results should be interpreted with caution given the small sample

lessons.title: 对话:论文答辩中的方法论质询
lessons.description: 面对答辩委员会的提问,捍卫研究方法

exercises.prompt: 论文答辩 — 提问与回答环节

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: We'll open the floor. Professor Demir, your first line of questioning, please.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Your sample is overwhelmingly drawn from urban respondents. How do you defend the generalisability of your claims?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 用学术模糊语承认局限,然后进行辩护
options: Yeah, that's a fair point, my sample is kind of weak there honestly.
I would readily concede the boundary, yet the patterns I identify hold across the urban strata I sampled, which I take pains to delimit in Chapter 4.
Generalisability isn't really my problem — the reader can decide.
turns.answer: I would readily concede the boundary, yet the patterns I identify hold across the urban strata I sampled, which I take pains to delimit in Chapter 4.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Granted. But your coding scheme appears to collapse two analytically distinct constructs into one variable. Was that deliberate?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 分裂句强调 — 请补全助动词
turns.after: precisely to avoid spurious distinctions in the pilot data that I merged them, and I document the decision rule in the appendix.
turns.answer: was

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Even so, you forgo the very contrast your literature review foregrounds. That strikes me as a methodological retreat.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 在反驳时,请选择礼貌的学术立场
options: With respect, I'd push back on that characterisation: the contrast survives in the robustness checks in Section 5.3.
Yeah no, you're totally right, I shouldn't have done that.
That's not fair and you know it.
turns.answer: With respect, I'd push back on that characterisation: the contrast survives in the robustness checks in Section 5.3.

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: Turning to your causal claim — the instrumental variable seems weak. Have you tested the exclusion restriction?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 分词结构 — 请填入正确的动词形式
turns.after: the standard diagnostics, the instrument clears the conventional thresholds, though I flag the residual uncertainty in the discussion.
turns.answer: Having run

turns.speaker: exam
turns.text: One final question. If you were to revisit the design, what would you change?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 请选择一种成熟的学术性自我反思
options: Nothing, the design is perfect as it stands.
Probably literally everything, it's a bit of a mess.
In hindsight, I would over-sample the rural strata and pre-register the coding scheme to forestall exactly the concerns you've raised.
turns.answer: In hindsight, I would over-sample the rural strata and pre-register the coding scheme to forestall exactly the concerns you've raised.

turns.speaker: chair
turns.text: Thank you. We'll move to the second examiner after a brief pause.

topics.title: 社会与政治
topics.description: 不平等、法律与公共辩论

guide.intro: 在社会议题的讨论中,词汇选择决定了政治语气。中文里的「国家」一词,在英语中可能对应 「state」、「government」 或 「public sector」,需视语境而定。C1 水平要求准确把握这些细微差别。

sections.text: 国家与政治相关术语
议题讨论的句式
讨论社会议题时,既要立场鲜明,又要立场平衡:「There is a strong case for X, but…」、「On balance,…」、「It is widely acknowledged that…」。

rows.source: There is a strong case for reform.
rows.translation: 推行改革的理由非常充分。

rows.source: On balance, the policy has done more good than harm.
rows.translation: 总体而言,该政策利大于弊。

rows.source: It is widely acknowledged that the system is in need of overhaul.
rows.translation: 体系需要彻底改造这一点已被普遍接受。

sections.text: 英文 「liberal」 的含义因国而异:在美国偏左中,在英国偏中间偏中,在澳大利亚则是中右政党的名称。同一词汇带有截然不同的政治联想。

lessons.title: 国家、政府与机构
lessons.description: 选择正确的术语

exercises.prompt: 术语 — 中文释义
「public sector」 是什么?
exercises.answer: 公共部门
exercises.explanation: 「public」 在政经语境中并非「公开的」,而是「公共/政府所属」;中文 L1 易混淆。

exercises.prompt: The ___ passed the bill last week.
exercises.answer: legislature
exercises.hint: 立法机构上周通过了这项法案。

exercises.prompt: 「公民社会在此次改革中扮演了至关重要的角色。」
exercises.answer: Civil society played a critical role in this reform

exercises.prompt: 在政治语境中,以下两个相关英文词 (一个偏「具体方针」,一个偏「政治活动」) 的区别是什么?
options: policy:某一领域的具体方针;politics:整体的政治活动/权力博弈
exercises.answer: policy:某一领域的具体方针;politics:整体的政治活动/权力博弈
exercises.explanation: 中文「政治」涵盖两者;英语中 policy ≠ politics 是 C1 必须分清的关键区别。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: The judiciary remains independent in principle.
options: The judiciary remains independent in principle.
The judiciary remain independent in principle.
The judiciaries remains independent in principle.
The judiciary remained independent in principal.
exercises.answer: The judiciary remains independent in principle.

exercises.prompt: Voters in this ___ tend to favour reform.
exercises.answer: constituency
exercises.hint: 这个选区的选民倾向于支持改革。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句呈现出中立的学术语气?
options: The damn government can't get anything right.
The government's policy choices have been mixed in their effects.
exercises.answer: The government's policy choices have been mixed in their effects.

exercises.prompt: 「政府颁布了一项新法律。」
exercises.answer: The government enacted a new law

exercises.prompt: The state has a ___ to protect citizens.
exercises.answer: duty
exercises.hint: 国家有义务保护公民。

lessons.title: 不平等讨论
lessons.description: 社会经济语言的细微差别

exercises.prompt: 术语 — 中文释义
「social mobility」 是什么?
options: 社会流动性(阶层之间的流动)
exercises.answer: 社会流动性(阶层之间的流动)
exercises.explanation: 「mobility」 此处 ≠ 「移动性」;指人在社会阶层间的上行/下行能力。中文「社会流动」是固定对应。

exercises.prompt: Income ___ has widened over the past decade.
exercises.answer: inequality
exercises.hint: 过去十年，收入差距不断扩大。

exercises.prompt: 「这一改革对最贫困群体产生了不成比例的影响。」
exercises.answer: The reform disproportionately affects the poorest

exercises.prompt: 「Disenfranchised」 是什么意思?
options: 权利被剥夺的 / 被排除的
exercises.answer: 权利被剥夺的 / 被排除的
exercises.explanation: 「dis- + franchise(选举权 / 特许权)」;中文「被剥夺权利的群体」是常见对应。注意中文 L1 易混淆 dis- / un- / non- 前缀。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Marginalised groups face systemic barriers.
exercises.answer: Marginalised groups face systemic barriers.

exercises.prompt: Closing the wage ___ remains a priority.
exercises.answer: gap
exercises.hint: 缩小薪酬差距仍然是当务之急。

exercises.prompt: 「systemic」 一词强调的是什么?
options: 结构性 / 系统性问题
exercises.answer: 结构性 / 系统性问题
exercises.explanation: 「systemic」 ≠ 「systematic」(后者指方法上的系统化);中文「系统性的问题」是社政话语固定对应。

exercises.prompt: 「过去十年间贫困水平变化甚微。」
exercises.answer: Poverty levels have changed little over the past decade

exercises.prompt: The proposal aims to ___ structural barriers.
exercises.answer: dismantle
exercises.hint: 该提案旨在消除结构性障碍。

lessons.title: 公共辩论
lessons.description: 权利、责任与平衡

exercises.prompt: 「On balance, the policy has done more good than harm」 用中文怎么说?
options: 总体而言,这项政策利大于弊。
在平衡之中,这项政策是坏的。
exercises.answer: 总体而言,这项政策利大于弊。
exercises.explanation: 「on balance」 = 「权衡之下/综合而言」,是 C1 公共话语的高频表达;中文 L1 易直译为「在平衡上」。

exercises.prompt: There is a strong ___ for reform.
exercises.answer: case
exercises.hint: 推行改革有充分的理由。

exercises.prompt: 议题讨论句式 — 中文释义
「人们普遍承认这一体系需要彻底改造。」
exercises.answer: It is widely acknowledged that the system needs an overhaul

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Critics argue that the policy is short-sighted.
options: Critics argue that the policy is short-sighted.
Critic argue that the policy is short-sighted.
Critics argues that the policies are short-sighted.
Critic arguing that the policy is short-sighted.
exercises.answer: Critics argue that the policy is short-sighted.

exercises.prompt: 「short-sighted」 用中文怎么说?
options: 目光短浅 / 鼠目寸光
exercises.answer: 目光短浅 / 鼠目寸光
exercises.explanation: 字面是「短视」,在政经话语中固定指「缺乏远见」;中文「目光短浅」最贴切。

exercises.prompt: Proponents ___ that the law protects vulnerable groups.
exercises.answer: claim
exercises.hint: 支持者声称该法律保护了弱势群体。

exercises.prompt: 「On the face of it」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 表面上看 / 乍一看
exercises.explanation: 中文 L1 直译「在脸面上」会错;习语整体记忆为「表面上,初看」。

exercises.prompt: 「这场讨论涉及多种细腻的视角。」
exercises.answer: The debate involves multiple nuanced perspectives

exercises.prompt: A more ___ approach is required.
exercises.answer: nuanced
exercises.hint: 需要采取一种更加细致的处理方式。

lessons.title: 不平等与政策语言
lessons.description: 讨论结构性不平等所用的正式语域

exercises.prompt: 政策术语 — 中文释义

pairs.right: 对低收入群体冲击不成比例的税种

exercises.prompt: 「A regressive tax」 是什么意思?
options: 对低收入者造成不成比例负担的税
exercises.answer: 对低收入者造成不成比例负担的税
exercises.explanation: 「regressive」 = 累退的(税法专用),意指越穷的人承担比例越高;中文「累退税」是固定对应。

exercises.prompt: The reform risks ___ existing disparities.
exercises.answer: entrenching
exercises.explanation: 「entrench」 = 使固化;「entrench inequality」 是常见搭配。
exercises.hint: 这项改革有可能进一步加剧现有的差距。

exercises.prompt: 「研究结果提供了反驳主流叙事的证据。」
exercises.answer: The findings offer evidence that undermines the prevailing narrative

exercises.prompt: 如何简洁地解释 「The policy disproportionately affects low-income households」?
options: 该政策对低收入家庭造成不成比例的影响
该政策对所有家庭影响相同
该政策影响的是高收入者
exercises.answer: 该政策对低收入家庭造成不成比例的影响
exercises.explanation: 「disproportionately」 是政经话语高频副词;中文「不成比例地 / 尤为严重地」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.
options: Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.
Far from levelling the playing fields, the reform may compounded existing inequities.
Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequity.
Far from levelled the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.
exercises.answer: Far from levelling the playing field, the reform may compound existing inequities.

exercises.prompt: The wealth ___ has widened in the past two decades.
exercises.answer: gap
exercises.hint: 过去二十年贫富差距不断扩大。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句保持了中立的学术语气?
options: Rich people are robbing the poor.
Distributional outcomes have shifted markedly upward.
exercises.answer: Distributional outcomes have shifted markedly upward.
exercises.explanation: 在学术性政治话语中,「distributional outcomes」 是中性表达。

exercises.prompt: 「政策讨论倾向于关注表象,而非结构性原因。」
exercises.answer: Policy debate tends to focus on symptoms rather than structural causes

exercises.prompt: Means-___ benefits target the most vulnerable.
exercises.answer: tested
exercises.explanation: 「Means-tested benefits」 = 以收入审查为条件的福利。
exercises.hint: 经济状况调查型福利针对的是最弱势的群体。

exercises.prompt: 在批评性文章中,「Trickle-down economics」 通常如何被引用?
options: 字面意义的「滴水经济学」
假设上层财富会「滴落」到下层的经济学(常被批评)
一种当代的凯恩斯主义模型
exercises.answer: 假设上层财富会「滴落」到下层的经济学(常被批评)
exercises.explanation: 「trickle down」 是隐喻型政策术语;中文常译「涓滴经济学」,批评者认为其假设是空想。

exercises.prompt: 「对特定群体产生不成比例影响的措施,需要特别的正当性论证。」
exercises.answer: Measures that disproportionately affect specific groups require particular justification

lessons.title: 公共话语策略
lessons.description: 框定议题、使用模糊语、有分寸的反对

exercises.prompt: 「It is often claimed that…」 这一表达的功能是什么?
options: 把流行观点框定出来,以便随后保持距离 / 加以反驳
exercises.answer: 把流行观点框定出来,以便随后保持距离 / 加以反驳
exercises.explanation: 「is claimed that」 = 「有人声称」,作者并不背书;此为公共话语中先框定后反驳的固定策略。

exercises.prompt: The argument is, at ___, incomplete.
exercises.answer: best
exercises.explanation: 「at best」 = 充其量(用于在话语中拉开距离)。
exercises.hint: 这种论证最多只能说是片面的。

exercises.prompt: 话语策略 — 功能
「该论证虽有可取之处,但证据基础较为薄弱。」
exercises.answer: While the argument has merit its evidentiary basis is thin

exercises.prompt: 「On closer inspection」 这一表达暗示了什么?
exercises.answer: 更仔细审视之后
exercises.explanation: 中文「细究之下」是常见对应;C1 公共话语中常用此句式做让步后转向。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Granted, the data are imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
options: Granted, the data are imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
Granted, the data is imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
Granted, the data are imperfected; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
Granted, the data are imperfect, that said, the trend is mistakable.
exercises.answer: Granted, the data are imperfect; that said, the trend is unmistakable.
exercises.explanation: 在学术英语中,「data」 作复数使用。

exercises.prompt: The claim is, to ___ a phrase, only half the story.
exercises.answer: borrow
exercises.explanation: 「to borrow a phrase」 是固定表达。
exercises.hint: 套用一句话来说，这种说法只讲了一半。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一句体现了「让步后反驳」(concede-and-rebut)的话语策略?
options: While there is some truth to that, it overlooks the broader pattern.
exercises.answer: While there is some truth to that, it overlooks the broader pattern.

exercises.prompt: 「关键在于我们错误地将这一问题归入了某一类别。」
exercises.answer: What matters is that we have miscategorised the problem

exercises.prompt: The data, ___ imperfect, point in the same direction.
exercises.answer: though
exercises.explanation: 「though imperfect」 = 尽管有瑕疵。
exercises.hint: 这些数据虽不完美，但都指向同一结论。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪一项体现了「框定议题」(framing)?
options: 用特定视角呈现某一议题
exercises.answer: 用特定视角呈现某一议题
exercises.explanation: 「framing」 是政治学/传媒学固定术语;中文「议题框定」是学术对应。

exercises.prompt: 「仔细阅读后,可以看出证据其实指向相反的结论。」
exercises.answer: On a careful reading the evidence says the opposite

lessons.title: 对话:关于不平等的市政厅会议
lessons.description: 在公开听证会上讨论公共政策

exercises.prompt: 市政厅 — 关于本地不平等问题的政策讨论

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: Tonight's agenda is the housing affordability gap in our district. The floor is open.

turns.speaker: res
turns.text: Rents have outpaced wages for a decade, and the council keeps recycling the same talking points. When do we see policy?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式发言:用分裂句转移重音
options: It's not the diagnosis that's missing, it's the political will to ring-fence funding for genuinely affordable units.
Yeah everything's bad, I dunno what to tell you honestly.
Look, the rich people are the problem, period, end of story.
turns.answer: It's not the diagnosis that's missing, it's the political will to ring-fence funding for genuinely affordable units.

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: Ring-fencing is one mechanism. Others have argued for inclusionary zoning. Where would you come down?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 正式让步状语 — 请填空
turns.after: inclusionary zoning has a mixed evidence base, I'd still prioritise it over deregulation, which historically benefits incumbents.
turns.answer: Granted

turns.speaker: res
turns.text: Easy for someone with a salary to say. What about families being priced out right now?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 尊重对方但立场清晰的反驳
options: Whatever, that's not my problem honestly.
Point taken — and that's precisely why any zoning reform must be paired with emergency rental assistance, not promised in lieu of it.
Calm down, it's just a discussion.
turns.answer: Point taken — and that's precisely why any zoning reform must be paired with emergency rental assistance, not promised in lieu of it.

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: The fiscal envelope is finite. If we fund rental assistance, something else gives. What would you cut?

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 倒装结构 — 请补全助动词
turns.before: Only by ring-fencing the vacancy tax revenue
turns.after: we avoid raiding the education line — which I take as politically off-limits.
turns.answer: can

turns.speaker: res
turns.text: And the developers? They'll lawyer their way out of any obligation, the way they always have.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 建设性的结尾:承认局限,同时提出机制方案
options: Enforcement is the achilles heel of every such scheme — which is why the ordinance should attach forfeiture clauses, not merely fines.
turns.answer: Enforcement is the achilles heel of every such scheme — which is why the ordinance should attach forfeiture clauses, not merely fines.

turns.speaker: mayor
turns.text: Thank you. I'll table a working draft incorporating tonight's points at the next session.

topics.title: 习语与搭配
topics.description: 让你说得地道的习语储备

guide.intro: 习语是任何语言的心脏。C1 水平要求熟记 「cut to the chase」、「on the back burner」 这类习语。将中文习语直译过去往往是危险的:「小题大做」对应英文的 「make a mountain out of a molehill」 或 「blow it out of proportion」,而不是字面直译。

sections.text: 商务场景中流行的习语

rows: 关键问题 / 最终结论
off the top of my head

sections.text: 假朋友与词汇陷阱
从中文到英语切换时,直接翻译习语是危险的做法。在断言「英语里有对应说法」之前,先查证一下。

rows.source: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill.
rows.translation: 别小题大做。(英语字面是「别把鼹鼠丘当成山」。)

rows.source: It's the elephant in the room.
rows.translation: 人人心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题。

rows.source: He's pulling your leg.
rows.translation: 他在拿你开玩笑。

rows.source: We need to bite the bullet.
rows.translation: 我们必须硬着头皮接受现实。

sections.text: 警惕「直译」习语的陷阱:中文「念叨个没完」在英语里并不是 「iron the head」,而是 「talk someone's ear off」 或 「drone on」。不要直译,要去寻找等效表达。

lessons.title: 职场习语
lessons.description: 会议语言的隐藏词典

exercises.prompt: 习语 — 中文释义
「Let's cut to the chase」 是什么意思?
options: 别绕弯子,我们直奔主题吧
exercises.answer: 别绕弯子,我们直奔主题吧
exercises.explanation: 源自电影术语「跳到追逐戏」;现已固定为「直奔要点」。中文「直奔主题」是最佳对应,不可字面翻译。

exercises.prompt: That project is ___ the back burner for now.
exercises.answer: on
exercises.hint: 那个项目目前先放一放。

exercises.prompt: 「我们从去年起就一直在提高标准。」
exercises.answer: We've raised the bar since last year

exercises.prompt: 「touch base with someone」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 与某人快速联络一下
exercises.explanation: 源自棒球术语;中文「碰个头 / 联络一下」是 idiom 对应。不可字面翻译为「触底」。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Let's touch base after the meeting.
options: Let's touch base after the meeting.
Let's touched base after the meeting.
Let's touch the base after the meeting.
Let's touched bases after the meeting.
exercises.answer: Let's touch base after the meeting.

exercises.prompt: The ___ line is, we need to ship by Friday.
exercises.answer: bottom
exercises.hint: 最关键的是，我们必须在星期五之前上线。

exercises.prompt: 「off the top of my head」 是什么意思?
options: 随口一说 / 凭印象估计
exercises.answer: 随口一说 / 凭印象估计
exercises.explanation: 习语整体记忆;不可字面理解。中文「凭印象 / 大致估计」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 「在这件事上,我们都同舟共济。」
exercises.answer: We're all in the same boat on this

exercises.prompt: Off the ___ of my head, I'd say twenty thousand.
exercises.answer: top
exercises.hint: 我随口估计大概是两万。

exercises.prompt: 「We need a ballpark figure」 是什么意思?
options: 我们要个体育场里的数字。
我们需要一个大概的数字。
我们要个加起来的总数。
exercises.answer: 我们需要一个大概的数字。
exercises.explanation: 「ballpark」 源自棒球场的比喻;「ballpark figure」 = 「估计 / 粗略数字」。中文 L1 易直译为「球场数字」。

exercises.prompt: 「我们别绕弯子,直奔主题吧。」
exercises.answer: Let's cut to the chase

lessons.title: 经典习语储备
lessons.description: 日常语言中色彩鲜明的习语

exercises.prompt: 习语 — 中文对应说法

pairs.left: make a mountain out of a molehill

pairs.right: 人人心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题

exercises.prompt: 「You're pulling my leg!」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 你在跟我开玩笑!
exercises.explanation: 经典习语;字面是「拉我的腿」,实义为「逗我玩」。中文 L1 必须整体记忆,不可拆解。

exercises.prompt: Don't make a ___ out of a molehill.
exercises.answer: mountain
exercises.hint: 别小题大做。

exercises.prompt: 「我们就咬牙接受这个事实吧。」
exercises.answer: Let's just bite the bullet

exercises.prompt: 「the elephant in the room」 是什么意思?
options: 房间里大象造型的装饰
所有人都心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题
exercises.answer: 所有人都心知肚明却避而不谈的大问题
exercises.explanation: 经典习语;中文里没有直接对应,但「心照不宣的问题」或「公开的秘密」是常用对应。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We need to address the elephant in the room.
options: We need to address the elephant in the room.
We need to addressed the elephant in the room.
We need to address the elephants in the room.
We need to addresses the elephant in the rooms.
exercises.answer: We need to address the elephant in the room.

exercises.prompt: I had to bite the ___ and tell the truth.
exercises.answer: bullet
exercises.hint: 我只好硬着头皮把实话说出来。

exercises.prompt: 「小题大做」 用英语怎么说?
options: make a mountain out of a molehill
kill a flea with a hammer
exercises.answer: make a mountain out of a molehill

exercises.prompt: 「我们来谈谈那个大家都避而不谈的大问题吧。」
exercises.answer: Let's talk about the elephant in the room

exercises.prompt: Stop pulling my ___
exercises.answer: leg
exercises.hint: 别开我玩笑了。

lessons.title: 假朋友(false friends)
lessons.description: 中文里容易混淆的陷阱

exercises.prompt: 英语 — 中文真实含义

pairs.right: 富有同情心的、能体谅的

exercises.prompt: 「sympathetic」 等同于中文里的「招人喜欢/讨喜」吗?
options: 不 ——「sympathetic」=「富有同情心 / 能体谅的」;若想表达「讨喜」请用 'likeable / charming'。
是的,但只用于文学语言。
exercises.answer: 不 ——「sympathetic」=「富有同情心 / 能体谅的」;若想表达「讨喜」请用 'likeable / charming'。
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:中文 L1 易因发音相近而误用;请记住 「sympathetic」 ≠ 「讨喜的」。

exercises.prompt: I read an interesting article in a science ___.
exercises.answer: magazine
exercises.explanation: 假朋友!中文里说的「八卦杂志」对应英文的 gossip magazine;但英文 「magazine」 泛指任何期刊杂志。
exercises.hint: 我在一本科学杂志上读到一篇有趣的文章。

exercises.prompt: 「sensible」 在英语中是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 明智的、有判断力的
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:中文 L1 常将 sensible 与 sensitive 混淆。「sensible」 = 「明智的」;「sensitive」 = 「敏感的」。

exercises.prompt: 「没确认之前不要发言。」
exercises.answer: Don't speak without checking

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Could you please check the figures one more time?
options: Could you please check the figures one more time?
Could you please control the figures one more time?
Could you please checks the figures one more times?
Could you please check the figure one more time?
exercises.answer: Could you please check the figures one more time?

exercises.prompt: This is a ___ topic; he gets upset easily.
exercises.answer: sensitive
exercises.hint: 这是个敏感话题，他容易动怒。

exercises.prompt: 「realize」 在英语中是什么意思?
options: 既指「意识到、察觉到」,也指「实现某项目」
exercises.answer: 既指「意识到、察觉到」,也指「实现某项目」
exercises.explanation: 中文 L1 通常只熟悉「实现」一义,但 「realize」 的常用义反而是「意识到」。「I realized my mistake」 = 「我意识到了我的错误」。

exercises.prompt: 「我最终意识到了自己的错误。」
exercises.answer: I eventually realized my mistake

exercises.prompt: The ___ cost was much higher than estimated.
exercises.answer: actual
exercises.hint: 实际成本比预估高得多。

lessons.title: 搭配训练
lessons.description: 自然的词组搭配

exercises.prompt: 搭配(collocation)— 中文释义
该用 「do」 还是 「make」?—— 表达「做决定」
exercises.answer: make a decision
exercises.explanation: 英语习惯说 「make a decision」;在英式英语中 「take a decision」 也可接受。

exercises.prompt: I need to ___ a phone call.
exercises.answer: make
exercises.hint: 我得打个电话。

exercises.prompt: 「我们愿意承担这一风险。」
exercises.answer: We are willing to take the risk

exercises.prompt: 下列哪个搭配是错误的?
exercises.answer: do progress
exercises.explanation: 正确说法是 「make progress」。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: We've made significant progress this quarter.
options: We've made significant progress this quarter.
We've done significant progress this quarter.
We've make significant progress this quarter.
We've made significant progresses this quarters.
exercises.answer: We've made significant progress this quarter.

exercises.prompt: Please ___ the law.
exercises.answer: obey
exercises.hint: 请遵守法律。

exercises.prompt: 该用 「do」 还是 「make」?—— 表达「制造噪音」
exercises.answer: make noise

exercises.prompt: 「考试前深深地吸一口气。」
exercises.answer: Take a deep breath before the exam

exercises.prompt: She made a strong ___ in her speech.
exercises.answer: impression
exercises.hint: 她的演讲给人留下了深刻印象。

lessons.title: 商务习语(第二轮)
lessons.description: 会议与战略语言中固化的表达

exercises.prompt: 习语 — 中文释义

pairs.right: 试图一口吞下所有问题

exercises.prompt: 「I don't have the bandwidth this week」 是什么意思?
options: 本周我没有时间 / 精力
exercises.answer: 本周我没有时间 / 精力
exercises.explanation: 源自电信术语,现代职场英语中固定为「个人工作精力 / 容量」;中文「我这周没带宽」是错误的字面翻译。

exercises.prompt: Let's not boil the ___; let's start small.
exercises.answer: ocean
exercises.hint: 我们别一口吃个胖子，先从小处入手。

exercises.prompt: 「这个数字真有可能让收入指针明显移动。」
exercises.answer: This figure could really move the needle on revenue

exercises.prompt: 「We're spread thin」 这一表达的含义是什么?
options: 我们的资源分散过度 / 不足
exercises.answer: 我们的资源分散过度 / 不足
exercises.explanation: 字面是「摊得太薄」;习语义为「人/资源分配过散,无法兼顾」。中文「人手不够 / 摊子铺得太大」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: Let's circle back on that once we have more clarity.
options: Let's circle back on that once we have more clarity.
Let's circle backed on that once we have more clarity.
Let's circle back on that once we had more clarity.
Let circle back on that once we have more clarity.
exercises.answer: Let's circle back on that once we have more clarity.

exercises.prompt: That decision is above my pay ___.
exercises.answer: grade
exercises.hint: 那个决定不归我的级别管。

exercises.prompt: 在会议上,「Let's take this offline」 是什么意思?
options: 我们另找时间单独讨论
exercises.answer: 我们另找时间单独讨论
exercises.explanation: 中文 L1 易理解为「离线」;但在职场语境是「散会后单独谈」。

exercises.prompt: 「这个决定超出我的职权,我们把它上升到更高层级。」
exercises.answer: This decision is above my pay grade let's escalate it

exercises.prompt: We need to get all our ducks in a ___ before the launch.
exercises.answer: row
exercises.hint: 发布之前我们得把所有事情安排妥当。

exercises.prompt: 「It's not a hill I'm willing to die on」 是什么意思?
options: 这件事我不会死磕到底
exercises.answer: 这件事我不会死磕到底
exercises.explanation: 军事隐喻;意为「这不是值得我拼到底的争议」。中文「我不会为此较真到底 / 这不是我的硬底线」是常见对应。

exercises.prompt: 「先摘容易摘的果实,再去处理难题。」
exercises.answer: Let's pick the low-hanging fruit first then tackle the hard problems

lessons.title: 假朋友(第二轮)与语域陷阱
lessons.description: 中文使用者容易忽略的细微差别

exercises.prompt: 容易混淆的词对 — 正确用法

pairs.right: 能体谅的(不是「招人喜欢的」)

exercises.prompt: 「I am actually going to the meeting」 是什么意思?
exercises.answer: 其实我是会去开会的
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:中文 L1 (尤其受 Romance 语言影响的二外学习者)易把 「actually」 当作「现在」(actualmente)。英语 「actually」 = 「其实 / 事实上」。

exercises.prompt: She is a very ___ person; she rarely overreacts.
exercises.answer: sensible
exercises.explanation: 「sensible」 = 明智的;「sensitive」 = 敏感的。
exercises.hint: 她是个非常理性的人，很少反应过度。

exercises.prompt: 「其实我们多年前就该解决这件事了。」
exercises.answer: Actually we should have solved this years ago

exercises.prompt: 「Eventually we agreed」 用中文怎么翻译?
exercises.answer: 最终我们达成了一致
exercises.explanation: 假朋友:「eventually」 ≠ 「最终也许、可能」;它等于「最终、终究」(指经过一段过程之后)。

exercises.prompt: 出你听到的句子
exercises.spokenText: I am sympathetic to your concern, but the policy stands.
options: I am sympathetic to your concern, but the policy stands.
I am sympathic to your concern, but the policy stand.
I am sympathetic to your concerns, but the policy stand.
I'm sympathetic to your concern, but the policies stands.
exercises.answer: I am sympathetic to your concern, but the policy stands.

exercises.prompt: The proposal is ___,if not optimal.
exercises.answer: defensible
exercises.hint: 这个提案就算不是最优，至少也站得住脚。

exercises.prompt: 下列哪种描述准确?「I would like to invite you to please reply at your earliest convenience.」
options: 过于冗赘正式;「I would appreciate a reply at your earliest convenience」 更顺
exercises.answer: 过于冗赘正式;「I would appreciate a reply at your earliest convenience」 更顺
exercises.explanation: C1 写作的细微点:中文 L1 容易堆砌礼貌副词,导致英语句子叠床架屋。「I would like to invite ... to please reply」 是冗赘组合,本族语者不这么说。

exercises.prompt: 「我们应当寻找用更少词语表达同样意思的方式。」
exercises.answer: We should look for a way to say the same thing in fewer words

exercises.prompt: I'd like to ___on that timeline.
exercises.answer: push back
exercises.hint: 我想对这个时间表提出异议。

exercises.prompt: 在商务语境中,「I'm comfortable with that」 最准确的含义是什么?
options: 这让我身体上感到舒适
我可以接受 / 我没有异议
exercises.answer: 我可以接受 / 我没有异议
exercises.explanation: 商务语境中 「comfortable with」 = 「接受 / 同意」,不是身体感受。中文 L1 易直译为「我感觉舒服」。

exercises.prompt: 「最后,我想就定价方面再提一点异议。」
exercises.answer: Finally I would like to push back on the pricing at one point

lessons.title: 对话:商务社交场合中的习语化交流

exercises.prompt: 行业大会酒会时段

turns.speaker: exec
turns.text: Quite the turnout this year. Half the panels were preaching to the choir, if I'm honest.

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: 习语用得对吗?请选出正确的回答
options: Couldn't agree more — and the keynote felt like it was hedging its bets right up to the closing line.
Yeah the keynote was hedging the bet so big.
Couldn't more agree — the keynote was on fire of pants.

turns.speaker: vc
turns.text: Speaking of fence-sitters, what's your read on the regulation? Are people actually going to move, or is this all hot air?

turns.speaker: you

Tell me of it — when procurement signs, the window of chance is closing.
